stem: What are the key features to observe during horizontal suspension in an infant being assessed for motor difficulties?
explanation: Head control and leg positioning are the key features to observe during horizontal suspension in an infant assessment.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because symmetry and stability are not the main features assessed during horizontal suspension.
optionExplanations.B: Correct because horizontal suspension is used to assess head control and leg positioning in an infant.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because posture and head control are not the stated key features for horizontal suspension.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because horizontal suspension is not limited to assessing proximal muscle power.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because visual fixation is not the focus of horizontal suspension for motor assessment.
